name: Obuse (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Obuse town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Obuse, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1956.

features.role: Obuse town emblem — a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar enclosing a stylised character
